// Chokepoint fixture (discipline-literals, GRND-06): a private discipline →
// citation-style map outside bin/lib/disciplines.ts. It drifts from the PRD §8
// preset table (History is Chicago notes-bibliography there, not author-date)
// — the rule must flag it.
const STYLE_BY_DISCIPLINE: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  'history': 'chicago-author-date',
};

export function styleFor(discipline: string): string {
  return STYLE_BY_DISCIPLINE[discipline] ?? 'apa';
}
